notes.title: Some things about the Patch and the "False Ending"
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Hope you're all enjoying "Space Bar at the End of the Galaxy", we certainly enjoyed making this game so we hope that our enthusiasm has translated into a fun experience for all. We want to address a few things as I think they may have inadvertently lead to people having a subpar experience with this game.

1. The Patch. If you want to enjoy the game with all it's features you need to put in the patch. You can find the instructions on the store page. If you see an animation of an asteroid flying by during your gameplay, then you know your patch wasn't installed.

2. False Ending. So, we decided to have some fun and put in a false ending when you [spoiler]  fail to convince Diana that you are Prinz Eugen [/spoiler]. This is actually a mission fail, but we figured it would be cool to write in an attempted escape and some people took this to be the end of the game and complained that it's too short. I'll give a little clue [spoiler] if everything goes to plan, you do get the secret formula then lots more story after that [/spoiler]

Anyway, just wanted to clear those things up so you can set it up right before starting the game!

Enjoy!
